neighbours.label: Verbs of breaking or shattering in languages other than English, literal or figurative: Spanish romper (rompieron, rompió), French casser (cassé, casse) and déchirer, Portuguese quebrar, Italian rompere (rotto), German zerbrechen, Arabic كسر; also English smash, shatter, burst. Also fires on words built on those stems with another meaning (Spanish 'rompecabezas', Arabic كسر as the vowel name). English break/broke fires only weakly. Quiet for crack, cut, split, bend, open, repair, and for the noun 'coffee break'.
fire: Los niños rompieron la ventana con un balón.
Elle a cassé son verre pendant le dîner.
O copo caiu e quebrou no chão da cozinha.
Ho rotto il telefono ieri sera.
Die Vase ist beim Umzug zerbrochen.
The storm made the old window shatter into pieces.
quiet: White appears to have attempted to flee, and was killed by an arrow through the heart.
Los niños limpiaron la ventana con un trapo.
Elle a rempli son verre pendant le dîner.
Il a plié la lettre en trois morceaux.
O copo caiu e rolou pelo chão da cozinha.
Ho riparato il telefono ieri sera.
Die Vase ist beim Umzug angekommen.
